lucy_support: FYI customer 'Invoiceify' opened a ticket — invoice summaries are truncating/dropping line items when item descriptions include quotes (single or double). They say it worked before last night's rollout. Attaching repro and request/response sample.

aj_devex: Can you paste the exact API call/request payload they used and which model version? Any rollout tag? :eyes:

lucy_support: Repro payload (sanitized customer data):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\n    "model": "rdx-3-small",\n    "model_version": "v2.1",\n    "input": "You are an invoice assistant. Given items: {{items}}\nReturn a markdown bullet list with description, qty, unit_price, total."\n  }'\n```
Sample items they sent: `- "Widget A" x2 $10
- 'Gizmo B' x1 $5
- "Special, \"Quoted\" Item" x3 $7`

When we run the same payload against pinned v2.0 the output is ok. On v2.1 the second and third items are merged/omitted or returned as a single malformed line.

deploy-bot: Deploy rdx-3-small v2.1 rolled to production @ 2023-11-09T03:12Z (canary 03:00Z -> full 03:12Z).

aj_devex: Interesting — sounds like prompt/template parsing is fragile to quotes now. Could be tokenizer boundary changes or a formatting postprocessor. Can you grab a raw request/response logs (headers + body) from the customer's failing attempt? Also confirm whether they used streaming or single-shot.

lucy_support: Customer used non-streaming. I pulled the raw response they pasted into the ticket, here's the relevant chunk:```
"output": "- Widget A x2 $10
- Gizmo B Special, \"Quoted\" Item x3 $7
"```
You can see quotes disappear and items merge.

sanjay_ml: My first guess: model variant v2.1 changed whitespace/tokenization/sectioning behavior (we did a tokenizer tweak and a small formatting head change). The example with escaped quotes could alter token alignments and our postprocessing that splits on newline/
 bullets may be brittle.

sanjay_ml: Quick repro script to test locally (python):
```python
from redwood import Client
rc = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = rc.generate(model="rdx-3-small", model_version="v2.1", input="You are an invoice assistant... items: - \"Widget A\" x2 $10
- 'Gizmo B' x1 $5")
print(resp.output)
```
I can run this in my env, but if we have a rollout difference between canary and full, might be related to the newer tokenization code path.

emily_prod: Customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported this in last 2 hrs, some automation failures (parsers downstream treat malformed output as error). Recommend short-term mitigation: pin affected customers to rdx-3-small@v2.0 or add a server-side pre-sanitizer that escapes quotes consistently before feeding into the prompt.

lucy_support: I've already pinned Invoiceify to v2.0 and notified them. They asked for ETA to fix.

ops-alert-bot: Alert: spike in support errors for rdx-3-small v2.1 — 14 related tickets in 120m.

aj_devex: Action items: (1) eng-ml (sanjay) to reproduce locally with exact payloads and confirm tokenizer/postprocess regression. (2) eng-runtime to check if any postdeploy config toggles (newline normalization, sanitize flags) changed during canary -> full. (3) Support to pin affected accounts and offer credits.

sanjay_ml: I'll triage now. If it's a tokenizer tweak regression I can try a quick hotfix to restore previous token splitting behavior or add safer bullet-splitting in postprocessing. Will update within 2 hours. :thinking:

lucy_support: Thanks — assigning follow-up to @sanjay_ml. I'll keep customer looped in and escalate if more accounts surface. :thumbsup:

emily_prod: Please include a short repro note and exact commit hash/rollout tag if we confirm root cause, so we can roll a patch and update release notes.

sanjay_ml: Starting with reproduce on my machine now. If anyone else has similar failing payloads, drop them here.

lucy_support: adding one more customer example (sanitized): `- "Line with apostrophe's test" x1 $3` — fails similarly.

aj_devex: Good data. Leaving thread for eng-ml to update. Thanks all.
